data.title: Rent increase request (Mieterhöhungsverlangen) for Heidekamp 9, EG links
data.summary: The property management company Immobilienverwaltung Musterheide OHG, acting for landlord Erbengemeinschaft Beispielmoor, asks tenant Bernd Exempelheide to consent to raising the net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) for Heidekamp 9, EG links from €560.00 to €616.00 per month, effective 1 February 2027.
data.explanation: This is a formal rent increase request under German law (§ 558 BGB), referring to the local Mietspiegel. It was personally delivered to your mailbox on 20 November 2026. You can agree, partly agree, or refuse; the law gives you until the end of the month after next following receipt to decide, which the app will show as the deadline. If you don't respond and don't agree, the landlord can only enforce the increase by suing for your consent in court - consider getting advice from a tenants' association (Mieterverein) if you're unsure whether the requested rent is justified before that deadline.
